dimensions.assessment: Affects up to 30 council members appointed by the Secretary of Commerce, federal agency officials, and manufacturing sector stakeholders.
dimensions.evidence: consist of not more than 30 individuals appointed by the Secretary with a balance of backgrounds

dimensions.assessment: Establishes an advisory and reporting body that provides recommendations and strategic plans but does not directly regulate private industry.
dimensions.evidence: provide a forum for regular communication between the Federal Government and the manufacturing sector

dimensions.assessment: Explicitly states that no additional funds are authorized to be appropriated.
dimensions.evidence: No additional funds are authorized to be appropriated to carry out this section.

dimensions.assessment: Creates a new statutory advisory council, transfers functions from an existing council, and mandates annual national strategic plans.
dimensions.evidence: establish within the Department of Commerce the National Manufacturing Advisory Council

dimensions.assessment: Includes a sunset provision terminating the council on September 30 of the fifth year after the year of its first meeting.
dimensions.evidence: The Advisory Council shall terminate on September 30 of the fifth year after the year in which the Advisory Council holds the first meeting

missing_information: Specific operational expenditures absorbed by existing Department of Commerce resources since no new funds are authorized.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill creates the National Manufacturing Advisory Council within the Department of Commerce, absorbing functions of an existing council, requiring periodic meetings, reports, and strategic plans.
